name: Bug Bus
description:
About This Game

Small passengers. A dangerous school run. A moving home that depends on you. Bug Bus is a single-player action and management game in a world seen from an insect's scale. Drive a walking, beetle-like bus through towering grass, then step inside to care for the young creatures aboard. Every journey connects the fight outside with the life you are building inside.

Turn the school run into an adventure


Collect young passengers from their stops and take them to the right schools. Giant roots, stones and hostile creatures stand between you and the next delivery. Follow the route, watch the school clock and bring your passengers home when lessons end. A successful day takes more than reaching a destination: leave with the supplies and equipment to handle the journey back.

Look after a lively little colony


Ants and worms have their own needs aboard the bus. Hungry passengers walk to the food stand, where you prepare their meals by choosing the right ingredients. Watch for arguments between species, step in to break up fights and keep their nests in good condition. Passengers contribute useful combat bonuses while active; caring for them also helps you protect the bus.

Make room for your passengers


Build and arrange nests inside your mobile home. Choose where each habitat belongs, move it when your layout changes and keep paths to the food stand and service areas clear. Switch to first person to walk through the bus and deal with problems up close. Your interior is a working space where passenger care, preparation and maintenance happen between trips.

Fight for a safe passage


Take control of the bus in third person and defend it against spiders and other hostile creatures. Use close-range blades, aimed laser fire or explosive weapons as your equipment develops. Manage ammunition, change weapons and use their special abilities to meet different threats. Pushing farther into the world brings tougher encounters, making preparation and knowing when to pull back part of each expedition.

Choose when to raise your shield


Defeating enemies supplies energy for the bus's protective shield. Keeping it active and absorbing hits consume that reserve, so decide when protection matters most. Electric, fire and radiation armor offer different effects while the shield is active. Combine your armor choice with weapon upgrades and runes to shape how you survive the next fight.

Repair the damage yourself


Damage can do more than lower a health bar. A broken leg affects movement, engine trouble slows the bus and a damaged weapon can stop working. Go inside, find the affected service panel and repair the part with materials from your inventory. Keeping the hull, legs, engine and weapons working is part of getting everyone through the day.

Use school hours to prepare

Once your passengers are in class, explore for resources and collect loot from defeated creatures. Bring materials back to the workbench to craft supplies, ammunition and equipment upgrades. Meals, repairs and improvements all compete for your stock, so decide what you need most before spending it. Complete daily tasks and return in time to continue the school run.

Grow stronger from one journey to the next


Improve your weapons, equip runes and develop the bus to unlock new options. Successful school deliveries provide species-specific essence for upgrading nests. Higher-level nests strengthen their residents' bonuses, while their meals require more demanding ingredients. Choose how far to expand your colony and keep its needs matched to the resources you can bring home.
short_desc: Safely transport young insects to their schools through a dangerous world. Customize your mobile home, the Bug Bus, care for your passengers, prepare its defenses, and explore for resources during school hours.
